core.name: Ngarla on the Ashburton river south of the Hamersley range

iso_retirement.comment:
Dr. Bowern judges the two languages Yinhawangka and Ngarla to be different. They
are associated with different locations, as provided on the New Code Request
form.

We believe that Dr. Bowern's research and expertise on languages of Australia,
as well as the support of the sources listed below are sufficient to define this
as a distinct language.
iso_retirement.name: Ngarla

endangerment.comment: Ngarla (4877-nlr) = Critically Endangered (20 percent certain, based on the evidence available) [Centre 2009](cldf:centre:09:15)
